cirrus.config.debug.tooltip: Log frame times and allocations every five seconds.
cirrus.config.title: %s settings
cirrus.config.text_cache.tooltip: Caches plain-string widths. Reloading fonts invalidates the cache.
cirrus.config.quad_encoding.tooltip: Uses native vertex writes and reuses position/normal scratch vectors.
cirrus.config.section_lighting.tooltip: Reuses light queries within a section rebuild.
cirrus.config.model_batching.tooltip: Transforms shared model corners once and writes cube vertices together.
cirrus.config.terrain_culling.tooltip: Skips wholly back-facing solid terrain groups before vertex processing. Enabling may rebuild chunks.
cirrus.config.particle_culling.tooltip: Skips off-screen billboard geometry on Minecraft 1.21.1. Particle ticking is unchanged.
cirrus.config.block_entity_culling.toolt: Skips off-screen bounded vanilla block entities on Minecraft 1.21.1.
cirrus.config.section_visibility.tooltip: Reuse section flood-fill storage to reduce allocations while rebuilding chunks.
cirrus.config.item_lod.tooltip: Draw at most two stack replicas past half the LOD distance, and one past the full distance. Item quantities remain unchanged.
cirrus.config.biome_sampling.tooltip: Reuse deterministic biome jitter per worker; terrain and biome results stay unchanged.
cirrus.config.terrain_lod.tooltip: Merge same-material planar faces into 2x2 / 4x4 patches at distance. Preserves silhouettes; distant texture and lighting details become coarser. Only solid terrain.
cirrus.config.chunk_batching.tooltip: Reuses GPU buffer bindings and chunk commands on 26.3, invalidating them when meshes change.
cirrus.config.texture_preparation.toolti: Speeds up texture preparation on startup and when reloading resources. The output stays pixel-identical.
cirrus.config.palette_packing.tooltip: Reuses temporary block and biome palette arrays while reading and saving chunks. Saved chunk data stays identical.
cirrus.config.density_buffers.tooltip: Reuse temporary density buffers while evaluating native ore veins.
cirrus.config.far_terrain.tooltip: Draws an approximate surface of previously loaded chunks beyond the detailed terrain.
cirrus.config.entity_occlusion.tooltip: Skips rendering entities and block entities completely hidden behind solid walls using compiled section occupancy masks.
